newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end lower on political uncertainties.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end lower on political uncertainties.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange closed lower in nervous trade as major investors stayed on the sidelines waiting for the current political scenario to end, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 1.96 points lower at 706.01.
"Traders are not in a position to make bulk purchases as the politiccal scenario is not right yet," said Sunil Prabhakar of brokers Spurt Securities.

The Congress party said it could review its make-or-break support for Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's minority ruling alliance, whose reciprocal support the Congress seeks for its ally, the Bahujan Samaj Party, in the state of Uttar Pradesh.
Elections in the state produced a hung assembly this month.
ACC lost 16 rupees to close at 1,664.0 in line with the overall sentiment, brokers said.
Reliance Industries quoted 0.95 rupee lower at 189.50. Larsen and Toubro was 2.50 rupees down at 211.10 on speculative selling, brokers said.
Hindustan Lever shed 6.0 rupees to close at 253.0.
